name: Analytic Tetrahedron Voxelization
aliases: Tetrahedral Voxelization with Philipp B's Algorithm
definition: A function that voxelizes a single tetrahedron onto a destination Cartesian grid, computing physically conservative moments (volume, linear, quadratic) for a specified polynomial order.
summary: Analytic Tetrahedron Voxelization converts tetrahedral meshes to grids by computing exact physical moments, avoiding aliasing and stochastic errors through deterministic planar graph clipping.
